originalTitle: Morning Mail: House price slide spreads across nation; Alan Jones trial due to start; Commonwealth Games conclude
summary: Australia’s housing market takes a hit; trial of former broadcaster Alan Jones to begin in Sydney; Commonwealth Games draws to a close
content: Good morning. New figures highlight how house prices have fallen nationwide in recent months – to the surprise of the Reserve Bank governor. There are fears that this year could become the worst on record for First Nations deaths in custody in New South Wales, after two men died last month at the Lithgow and Clarence correctional centres. Australia’s athletes have ended their Commonwealth Games on a golden high, and the trial of Alan Jones is due to begin today in Sydney. Australia Exclusive | After two men died in correctional centres in July, First Nations advocates warn that prisons in NSW could exceed last year’s record number of Indigenous deaths in custody. Alan Jones trial | The trial of former broadcaster Alan Jones on charges of indecent assault and sexual touching is scheduled to begin in Sydney, with 76 witnesses expected across four months. Market cools | House prices have fallen in Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth as the market downturn spreads across Australia with the Middle East conflict and tax changes beginning to bite. ‘Incredibly far-ranging’ | Queensland is considering a bill to “streamline” major projects by bypassing conservation and planning laws – but it is raising alarm bells for property owners. Temperature Check | Karl Stefanovic’s “great net zero debate” was anything but – so beware the Coalition claims of renewables taking over “two Tasmanias” in terms of land, Graham Readfearn writes. World Middle East crisis | Donald Trump says he cancelled military strikes against Iran on the basis of “rapidly” reaching a deal on its nuclear program and the reopening of the strait of Hormuz. Wildfire tragedy | Two Australian firefighting helicopters have collided in gale-force winds near Athens, amid frantic efforts to control a massive wildfire barrelling towards the outskirts of the Greek capital. ‘All I need is a chance’ | The chaos of their border crossing gives way to limbo for Moroccans on Ceuta’s streets as they face uncertain prospects after more than 50,000 people entered the Spanish enclave. Elisabeth-Jane Ross | Greek police say a man has been arrested over the death of a Scottish woman whose body was found in a suitcase by a homeless man in a derelict building in Athens. Drought impact | There are warnings that Britain could face food shortages as farmers battle to salvage what they can of their crops with parts of England suffering a punishing drought. Full Story Your guide to Alan Jones’ trial Alan Jones will today front court on 22 charges of indecent and sexual assault, spanning a nearly two-decade period. He denies all charges. Once a media giant who enjoyed the height of influence and power, he is now the centre of one of Australia’s highest-profile criminal cases. Amanda Meade joins Nour Haydar to get us up to speed on the trial. In-depth In the 1990s, a mystery virus in Australia started killing horses. Then humans. Epidemiologists scouring for clues in their quest to find out how the virus had jumped to humans from horses then discovered its origin: bats. In his new book, Sentinels: When Diseases Spread Between Humans and Animals, author Michael Delaney asks whether this was the moment our coronavirus era began. Not the news In the latest in our Kindness of strangers series, we hear from a reader who found themselves injured, starving and dehydrated after hiking to find an incredible waterfall deep in the Thai rainforest. They wonder what might have happened if a fellow backpacker they had only met a few hours earlier hadn’t picked them up and carried them back towards safety. Sport Commonwealth Games | “Never give up”: Australian para bowler Louise Hoskins, 76, won a historic gold medal; and Australia capped off its medal table dominance with golds for track cyclists Tara Neyland, Leigh Hoffmann and Alyssa Polites. Before the closing ceremony (featuring Delta Goodrem), the Glasgow 2026 chief hailed the “phenomenal success” of the revamped Commonwealth Games. AFL | Josh Fraser has morphed from low-key interim coach to the best man for the top Carlton job, Jonathan Horn writes. Football | Pressure on embattled Fifa boss Gianni Infantino is increasing as Uefa members prepare to oppose his re-election. Cycling | Lorena Wiebes won again on stage two of the Tour de France Femmes to retain the yellow jersey; the UCI president backed night-time drug testing after the Tour de France controversy. Olympics | Concept plans for Brisbane’s Olympic stadium precinct have been revealed – but critics say they are “fantasy vision”. Media roundup A former Asio agent has made a new bid to return to Australia to give evidence to the Bondi royal commission despite being denied a visa, ABC News reports. Police say the scale of child abuse in NSW has become an epidemic with more than 300 incidents reported to authorities each week, the Sydney Morning Herald reports. What’s happening today NSW | The trial of former broadcaster Alan Jones begins today in Sydney. ACT | A public hearing in the inquiry into the Interactive Gambling Amendment (Gambling Reform) Bill is being held in Canberra. WA | The Diggers and Dealers Mining Forum begins today in Kalgoorlie. QLD | A public hearing is scheduled in Brisbane in the inquiry into the Support at Home Program. chineseTitle: 早间邮报：全国房价下滑；艾伦·琼斯审判即将开始；英联邦运动会闭幕
chineseSummary: 澳大利亚房地产市场遭受重创；前广播员艾伦·琼斯的审判将在悉尼开始；英联邦运动会接近尾声
chineseContent: 早上好。新数据突显了近几个月来全国范围内房价的下跌，这令储备银行行长感到惊讶。继上个月两名男子在利思戈和克拉伦斯惩教中心死亡后，人们担心今年可能成为新南威尔士州有记录以来原住民在拘留期间死亡人数最多的一年。澳大利亚运动员以黄金般的成绩结束了他们的英联邦运动会，艾伦·琼斯的审判将于今天在悉尼开始。澳洲独家|七月份两名男子在惩教中心死亡后，原住民倡导者警告说，新南威尔士州监狱中原住民在押死亡人数可能会超过去年的创纪录数字。艾伦琼斯审判|对前广播员艾伦·琼斯 (Alan Jones) 指控猥亵和性接触的审判定于悉尼开始，预计四个月内将有 76 名证人出庭。市场降温 |随着中东冲突和税收变化开始影响澳大利亚市场低迷，布里斯班、阿德莱德和珀斯的房价下跌。 “范围极其广泛”|昆士兰州正在考虑一项法案，通过绕过保护和规划法来“简化”重大项目，但这给业主敲响了警钟。体温检查 |卡尔·斯特凡诺维奇（Karl Stefanovic）的“伟大的净零辩论”绝非如此——因此请注意联盟党关于可再生能源接管“两个塔斯马尼亚州”土地的说法，格雷厄姆·里德费恩（Graham Readfearn）写道。世界中东危机|唐纳德·特朗普表示，他以“迅速”就伊朗核计划达成协议和重新开放霍尔木兹海峡为由，取消了对伊朗的军事打击。山火悲剧|两架澳大利亚消防直升机在雅典附近的强风中相撞，当时正在疯狂地努力控制一场正在肆虐的大火。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
